abstract: Vertical restraints imposed on some downstream buyers can affect non-contracted firms by weakening upstream suppliers’ effective viability. We study these contracting externalities using Intel’s exclusionary agreements with PC manufacturers in the microprocessor market. Combining litigation-based measures of restraints with PC data, we estimate dynamic models of AMD adoption that allow for cross-buyer spillovers. We find that exclusivity imposed on a given buyer significantly reduces adoption by other, non-contracted buyers, generating sizable and persistent market-wide effects. The paper provides the first empirical quantification of the economic magnitude of contracting externalities and highlights the broader competitive risks posed by exclusionary contracting.
abstract_zh: 对部分下游买家施加的纵向限制可能通过削弱上游供应商的有效生存能力，对非签约企业产生影响。本文利用英特尔在微处理器市场与个人电脑制造商签订的排他性协议，研究此类契约外部性。通过将基于诉讼的约束措施与个人电脑数据相结合，我们估计了允许跨买家溢出效应的AMD采纳动态模型。研究发现，对特定买家施加的排他性条款会显著降低其他非签约买家的采纳率，产生规模可观且持续的市场整体效应。本文首次对契约外部性的经济规模进行实证量化，揭示了排他性契约带来的更广泛竞争风险。
title: Incapacitating the Competition: The Impact of Vertical Restraints on Technology Adoption
title_zh: 削弱竞争：纵向约束对技术采纳的影响

abstract: We study a model of popular demand for anti-elite populist reforms that drain the swamp: replace experienced public servants with novices that will only acquire experience with time. Voters benefit from experienced public servants because they are more effective at delivering public goods and more competent at detecting emergency threats. However, public servants’ policy preferences do not always align with those of voters. This tradeoff produces two key forces in our model: public servants’ incompetence spurs disagreement between them and voters, and their effectiveness grants them more power to dictate policy. Both of these effects fuel mistrust between voters and public servants, sometimes inducing voters to drain the swamp in cycles of anti-elite populism. We study which factors can sustain a responsive democracy or induce a technocracy. When instead populism arises, we discuss which reforms may reduce the frequency of populist cycles, including recruiting of public servants and isolating them from politics. Our results support the view that a more inclusive and representative bureaucracy protects against anti-elite populism. We provide empirical evidence that lack of trust in public servants is a key force behind support for anti-elite populist parties and argue that our model helps explain the rise of anti-elite populism in large robust democracies.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种反精英民粹主义改革的大众需求模型，该改革旨在“排干沼泽”：用缺乏经验的新人替换经验丰富的公务员，而这些新人将随时间积累经验。选民受益于经验丰富的公务员，因为他们能更有效地提供公共产品，并更胜任识别紧急威胁。然而，公务员的政策偏好并不总是与选民一致。这种权衡在我们的模型中产生了两种关键力量：公务员的无能加剧了他们与选民之间的分歧，而他们的有效性则赋予他们更多主导政策的权力。这两种效应都加剧了选民与公务员之间的不信任，有时会诱使选民以反精英民粹主义的周期循环“排干沼泽”。我们研究了哪些因素能够维持回应型民主或催生技术官僚体制。当民粹主义出现时，我们讨论了哪些改革可能减少民粹主义周期的频率，包括公务员的招募以及使其与政治隔离。我们的结果支持以下观点：更具包容性和代表性的官僚体系能够抵御反精英民粹主义。我们提供了实证证据，表明对公务员缺乏信任是支持反精英民粹主义政党的关键力量，并论证我们的模型有助于解释大型稳健民主国家中反精英民粹主义的兴起。
title: Drain the Swamp: A Theory of Anti-Elite Populism
title_zh: 排干沼泽：反精英民粹主义理论

abstract: We study how institutional constraints on executive selection shape redistributive policy, using a 1919 Danish reform that allowed town councils to democratically elect mayors. While the reform applied uniformly across towns, it made left-wing executive control politically feasible for the first time, particularly in towns with stronger prior support for the Social Democratic party. Exploiting predetermined Social Democratic vote shares from the 1917 election interacted with the post-reform period, we identify the causal effect of Social Democratic executive control on local public finance. We show that Social Democratic mayors substantially increased social spending, especially on poor relief and public assistance, with these expansions financed primarily through higher direct taxes. We find no robust evidence that these policies reduced local economic activity. The results highlight how removing institutional constraints on executive selection can translate latent voter preferences into concrete redistributive policy outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1919年丹麦的一项改革（该改革允许市镇委员会民主选举市长）来研究行政长官选拔的制度约束如何影响再分配政策。尽管改革统一适用于所有市镇，但它首次使左翼行政长官控制权在政治上成为可能，尤其是在那些先前对社会民主党支持度较高的市镇。通过利用1917年选举中既定的社会民主党得票率与改革后时期的交互作用，我们识别出社会民主党行政长官控制权对地方公共财政的因果效应。研究表明，社会民主党市长显著增加了社会支出，尤其是贫困救济和公共援助，这些扩张主要通过提高直接税来融资。我们没有发现这些政策抑制地方经济活动的稳健证据。研究结果凸显了消除行政长官选拔的制度约束如何将潜在的选民偏好转化为具体的再分配政策结果。
title: Left in Charge: Political Rule and the Rise of Local Welfare
title_zh: 留守掌权：政治统治与地方福利的兴起

title: Trade fragmentation, inflationary pressures and monetary policy
title_zh: 贸易碎片化、通胀压力与货币政策

title: Price incentives and unregulated deforestation: Evidence from Indonesian palm oil mills
title_zh: 价格激励与无管制森林砍伐：来自印尼棕榈油厂的证据
